approval.scope: Exact static mounted-weapons source; no animation or camouflage approval

authorization: George: Ok let’s proceed, following agreed NATO, overall green and winter set; approved desert remains immutable

references.title: TB43-0209 Figure91,p196–197
references.author: Department of the Army; hosted by Integrated Publishing
references.license: Government-authored figure via mirror; reference pixels excluded from archive
references.use: Actual M1A1 top/right/left/front/rear pattern, smooth irregular interlocking fields, cross-view boundaries and band anchors; not generic noise.

references.author: Department of the Army
references.use: Green/brown/black, numbered color fields; fixed-feature pattern reference points. Do not apply color percentages for one example as automatically exact to everyvehicle.

references.author: SSG Ange Desinor,USArmy,April10,2017
references.use: Documents temporary green repaint of M1A2 tanks for Europe; supports Abrams family treatment, not exact legacyM1A1 identification.

references.author: USArmy CALL,June2017,p43
references.use: Temporary snowcamouflage for Abrams discussed; notes nonspecific doctrine and units developing patterns. Does not supply exact M1A1 winter template.

references.author: USArmy Armor,March–April1996
references.use: Seasonal whitewash discussed specifically for Abrams concealment; not one uniquely prescribed scheme.

retain: 269 meshes and all geometry, parents, pivots, T158 shoes, crew hatches and weapon rest geometry
Matte painted metal, original steel/rubber/glass properties
Existing seam and edge accent geometry
style.change: Paint regions only, with palette-matched existing seam/highlight colors

finishTargets.nato: Broad irregular green/brown/black bands and lobes inspired by TB43-0209 Figure91, not an exact stencil reconstruction or measured paint specification
finishTargets.green: Overall green with restrained roof/hatch value separation, Abrams-family treatment supported by2017 Army repaint report; not specific photographed M1A1 unit replication
finishTargets.winter: Predominantly off-white temporary field-style overpaint with restrained green islands; Army CALL p43 states pattern guidance non-specific. No claim of official M1A1 winter template

projection.method: Rasterize actual selected paint triangles into dominant-normal atlas tiles and retain nearest directional depth. Evaluate original continuous3D color fields at those surface coordinates. Five tonal copies share registered boundaries. Fill2pixel texture gutters only.
limitations: Orthographic atlas projection can overlap hidden surfaces; inspect seams in all6views and native/export UVs. Colors are stylized approximations, not colorimetric CARC matches.
Atlas is authoring UV support, not directional runtime imagery. No geometry overlay patches.

verification: Producer health, fresh dimensions and baseline before mutation
Packed Blender/GLB texture hash identity, UV/image native fingerprints and mesh isolation
Independent adversarial review and hash-bound rubric per finish
Human approval absent until exact named finish decision
